def parse_ordinal_datetime(value, year):
    """Parse values like '9th Aug 10:06' into a real datetime."""
    if value is None:
        raise ValueError("A2 is blank; cannot convert Last Online value.")
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value

    text = str(value).strip()
    match = re.match(
        r"^\s*(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+([A-Za-z]+)\.?\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(AM|PM|am|pm)?\s*$",
        text
    )
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse date/time value: {value!r}")

    day = int(match.group(1))
    month_text = match.group(2).lower().rstrip(".")
    hour = int(match.group(3))
    minute = int(match.group(4))
    second = int(match.group(5) or 0)
    ampm = match.group(6)

    month_map = {}
    for i in range(1, 13):
        month_map[calendar.month_abbr[i].lower()] = i
        month_map[calendar.month_name[i].lower()] = i

    month = month_map.get(month_text) or month_map.get(month_text[:3])
    if not month:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown month name in value: {value!r}")

    if ampm:
        ampm = ampm.lower()
        if ampm == "pm" and hour != 12:
            hour += 12
        elif ampm == "am" and hour == 12:
            hour = 0

    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, second)

def parse_last_online(value, default_year=2021):
    """
    Parse strings like '9th Aug 10:08' into a real Python datetime.
    The source text has no year; the requested standardized example uses year '21',
    so 2021 is the deterministic year used for the conversion.
    """
    if value is None:
        raise ValueError("Source cell is blank; cannot convert date/time.")
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.replace(year=default_year) if value.year == 1900 else value

    text = str(value).strip()
    # Accept day suffixes (st/nd/rd/th), full or abbreviated month names, and HH:MM[:SS].
    m = re.match(
        r"^\s*(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*$",
        text,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse date/time from {value!r}")

    day = int(m.group(1))
    mon_txt = m.group(2).lower()
    hour = int(m.group(3))
    minute = int(m.group(4))
    second = int(m.group(5) or 0)

    month_lookup = {}
    for i in range(1, 13):
        month_lookup[calendar.month_abbr[i].lower()] = i
        month_lookup[calendar.month_name[i].lower()] = i
    # Also support partial 3-letter abbreviation with optional period
    mon_txt = mon_txt.rstrip(".")
    if mon_txt not in month_lookup:
        mon_txt3 = mon_txt[:3]
        if mon_txt3 in month_lookup:
            month = month_lookup[mon_txt3]
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown month in {value!r}")
    else:
        month = month_lookup[mon_txt]

    return datetime(default_year, month, day, hour, minute, second)
